```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE, error = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(SingleCellExperiment)
    library(Matrix)
})
```

Expected: **`r params$n_cells`** cells, with the genes and UMIs per cell of
the simulated count matrix in `true_mex/`.

# Load count matrices

```{r load}
sce <- readRDS(params$sce_path)
mat <- assay(sce, 'counts')
cat(sprintf('Count matrix dimensions: %d genes x %d cells\n', nrow(mat), ncol(mat)))

truth <- readMM(gzfile(file.path(params$true_mex_dir, 'matrix.mtx.gz')))
colnames(truth) <- readLines(gzfile(file.path(params$true_mex_dir, 'barcodes.tsv.gz')))
rownames(truth) <- read.table(gzfile(file.path(params$true_mex_dir, 'features.tsv.gz')),
                              sep = '\t')$V1
```

# Cell recovery

```{r cells}
n_recovered <- ncol(mat)
expected_cells <- as.integer(params$n_cells)
cat(sprintf('Recovered %d cells (expected %d): %s\n',
            n_recovered, expected_cells,
            ifelse(n_recovered == expected_cells, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# Gene recovery

```{r genes}
n_genes_detected <- sum(rowSums(mat) > 0)
expected_genes <- sum(rowSums(truth) > 0)
cat(sprintf('Detected %d genes (expected %d): %s\n',
            n_genes_detected, expected_genes,
            ifelse(n_genes_detected == expected_genes, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# UMI counts

UMIs per cell are compared with the simulated totals of the same barcode;
a cell passes within 1 % of its simulated total.

```{r umis}
shared <- intersect(colnames(mat), colnames(truth))
umis_per_cell <- colSums(mat[, shared, drop = FALSE])
true_umis_per_cell <- colSums(truth[, shared, drop = FALSE])
relative_difference <- abs(umis_per_cell - true_umis_per_cell) / pmax(true_umis_per_cell, 1)
umis_pass <- length(shared) > 0 && all(relative_difference <= 0.01)

cat(sprintf('UMIs per cell: median %g (simulated %g), largest relative difference %.4f over %d cells: %s\n',
            median(umis_per_cell), median(true_umis_per_cell),
            max(relative_difference, 0), length(shared),
            ifelse(umis_pass, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))

if (length(shared) > 0) {
    plot(true_umis_per_cell, umis_per_cell,
         xlab = 'simulated UMIs per cell', ylab = 'recovered UMIs per cell',
         pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = 'steelblue')
    abline(0, 1, col = 'red', lty = 2)
}
```

# Counts per gene and cell

Recovered counts are compared with the simulated counts entry by entry, on the
shared barcodes; a simulated gene missing from the recovered matrix counts as
zeros. The difference is the sum of absolute differences over the simulated
total, and passes within 1 %.

```{r entries}
recovered_aligned <- matrix(0, nrow(truth), length(shared),
                            dimnames = list(rownames(truth), shared))
in_both <- intersect(rownames(truth), rownames(mat))
recovered_aligned[in_both, ] <- as.matrix(mat[in_both, shared, drop = FALSE])
truth_shared <- as.matrix(truth[, shared, drop = FALSE])
entry_difference <- sum(abs(recovered_aligned - truth_shared)) / max(sum(truth_shared), 1)
entries_pass <- length(shared) > 0 && entry_difference <= 0.01

cat(sprintf('Gene by cell counts: %d genes in both, difference %.4f of the simulated total: %s\n',
            length(in_both), entry_difference, ifelse(entries_pass, 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# Barcode recovery

```{r barcodes}
expected_barcodes <- readLines(params$barcodes_path)
recovered_barcodes <- colnames(mat)
n_matched <- sum(recovered_barcodes %in% expected_barcodes)
cat(sprintf('%d / %d recovered barcodes match simulated whitelist: %s\n',
            n_matched, length(recovered_barcodes),
            ifelse(n_matched == length(recovered_barcodes), 'PASS', 'FAIL')))
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
pass <- n_recovered == expected_cells &&
    n_genes_detected == expected_genes &&
    umis_pass &&
    entries_pass &&
    n_matched == length(recovered_barcodes)

cat(sprintf('\nOverall validation: %s\n', if (pass) 'PASS' else 'FAIL'))
```
